sub_indicators.label: Statistics law
sub_indicators.subject: gov.legislate
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country has no statistics law and no draft of one.

A bill or draft exists: published, validated, out for consultation, before cabinet or parliament, or passed and not yet promulgated. A law that is only announced or planned does not count. A statistics office set up by an ordinary decree, with no statistics law behind it, stops here.
A statistics law is in force, however old: an act, ordinance or decree with the force of law that governs official statistics or sets up the national statistics office.
A decree, regulation or order has been made under the law: on the statistics office, the statistics council or board, the approval of surveys or the confidentiality of data.

The law has been applied in the past three years: its council or board appointed or meeting, a standard, release calendar or survey approval issued under it, a rule made under it, or a penalty. A census or survey carried out, a strategy or a budget does not reach this stage.

aspects.name: Rules made under the law and the law applied
